column11: judgement on filed timing, and the row most likely to move. Wave's FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-073472) states 'We plan to file a New Drug Application in 2026 to support accelerated approval of WVE-N531 with monthly dosing.' The Q3 2026 10-Q (0001193125-26-432714) does not repeat that plan and says instead 'We continue partnering discussions for WVE-003 and WVE-N531', so no filing is confirmed. A submission in 2027 and a priority review of an original NDA, 60 days plus 6 months on data/fda_review_clock.csv (PDUFA VII I.A.1.b and I.B.4), puts approval in 2028 with 2029 the first full year
column12: Case for earlier: rare paediatric disease and orphan drug designations were granted in the third quarter of 2024, and an accelerated approval on dystrophin is the precedent in this class. Case for later: the registrational extension NCT07209332 has a primary completion of 2029-03, and the Q3 silence and partnering talk read as a programme waiting for a partner to fund it

column12: MEASURED AND WRONG IN THE BUILD: an oligonucleotide is filed as a drug under an NDA, not as a biologic under a BLA, so its statutory term should be the small-molecule one rather than the twelve-year biologic floor. The book reads no modality for this asset and WVE-N531 carries no INN stem to read one from, so assumptions.load hands the engine unknown and data/loe_defaults.csv gives it the twelve-year floor: the build loses exclusivity in 2041, two years earlier than an NDA term would. Fix it by recording the modality on the asset, not by moving this row
